title: Replace the git-secrets job in code-health.yml with a pinned gitleaks 8.30.1 scan
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/.github/workflows/code-health.yml, replace the run-git-secrets job (lines 193-206, which runs sudo apt-get install git-secrets and git-secrets --register-aws && git-secrets --scan) with a job named secrets-gitleaks. The new job: installs gitleaks 8.30.1, the version pinned in .claude/skills/scanner-toolchain/references/toolchain.json, from the GitHub release tarball and verifies its sha256 (linux x64: 551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb) before running it; or it uses gitleaks/gitleaks-action pinned to a full commit SHA. It checks out with fetch-depth: 0 and persist-credentials: false, runs gitleaks git --redact --exit-code 1 on push and on the PR commit range, and keeps the existing actions-permissions monitor with contents: read only. Add .gitleaks.toml at the repo root that extends the default ruleset and adds a rule for MongoDB connection strings with embedded credentials (mongodb(+srv)?://user:password@). The default ruleset already covers the GitHub, npm and Atlassian/JIRA tokens that this repo's workflows handle. Remove the dependabot/fork if-condition only if the fork workflow (code-health-fork.yml) does not already run a secrets scan; otherwise add the same job there. Policy constraint: sdlc/policy.json ciGates secrets = gitleaks, blocking true, minSeverityToBlock low, so any finding fails the job.
acceptanceCriteria: grep -rn 'git-secrets' .github/workflows/ returns no match, and code-health.yml contains a job that runs gitleaks version 8.30.1 after a sha256 or commit-SHA-pinned install
A test PR that adds a fake mongodb+srv://user:pass@host connection string and a fake GitHub token to a scratch file fails the secrets-gitleaks job with exit code 1; the same PR without them passes
.gitleaks.toml exists at the repo root and gitleaks git --config .gitleaks.toml runs locally without a configuration error
probe-cicd-env no longer emits CICD-GATE-06 for .github/workflows/code-health.yml (fingerprint 752f7d6cef271fa5121bf0cbaf630e849eadbb911df0abaf79f5d7fb72d7001f)

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-cicd-env for mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server. Expected: the secrets gate found in CI is gitleaks with a blocking exit code, matching policy.json ciGates, and no CICD-GATE-06 result is produced.

rootCause.description: The CI secrets check was inherited from the upstream project as git-secrets registered only with AWS patterns, and was never aligned with the company policy's blocking gitleaks gate. As a result, GitHub, npm, JIRA and MongoDB credentials are not detected.
